description: This is a Java Spring MVC controller class for managing 'Profesor' entities. It defines endpoints for CRUD operations on professors, including creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving professor details, with role-based access control annotations.

classes.name: ProfesorController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller handling CRUD and view rendering for Profesor entities, with role-based access restrictions.

methods.name: addProfesor
methods.description: Displays form to add a new profesor.

methods.name: saveProfesor
methods.description: Handles POST request to save a new profesor.

methods.name: getProfesorForUpdate
methods.description: Loads existing profesor data for editing.

methods.name: updateProfesor
methods.description: Handles POST request to update an existing profesor.

methods.name: getProfesoresList
methods.description: Returns a list of all profesores.

methods.name: getProfesorDetail
methods.description: Displays detailed view of a specific profesor and their courses.
